response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished, versatile senior engineer with 13+ years of experience, but the profile is overwhelmingly web/full-stack (TypeScript, Node.js, D, Ember/React) rather than C++ systems engineering. Documented C++ work is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a university thesis project — over a decade ago — and C++/STL does not even appear in the listed skills. There is no evidence of industrial automation, IoT protocols (MQTT, Modbus, OPC UA), message-broker-based C++ architectures, IEC 62443 / Secure Development Lifecycle practice, or Azure. Some transferable strengths exist (low-latency distributed services, event-driven platforms, testing rigor, mentoring), but the core technical and security requirements of this role are unmet.
strengths: Deep experience with low-latency, high-throughput distributed and event-driven systems
Strong engineering craft: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, mentoring and public teaching
Broad polyglot background including some C/C++ and embedded/hardware exposure
concerns: C++/STL experience is minimal and over a decade out of date
No industrial automation, IEC 62443/SDL, or IoT protocol (MQTT/Modbus/OPC UA) background
Recent career trajectory is web/full-stack, not systems-level platform development

key_factors.factor: Missing industrial cybersecurity (IEC 62443/SDL) and automation domain
Senior-level distributed systems and engineering-practice depth
